notes_for_us: The shape catalogue calls rooms-sequence **Zone (Room Sequence)** but Shooter's own table calls it **Path (Breach Sequence)** and the segments example in genre-choice/SKILL.md emits it as type Path. Type is part of the Shared Vocabulary the pipeline reads, so a reworded Type is not the same as a reworded name — one of the three is wrong.

Naming a second genre is called free in step 2, but the same step says to load a genre that is doing real work. Horror here does real work on theme and none on options, and there is no way to record 'named, deliberately not loaded' other than a note.

A scripted scene order — nine objectives in a fixed sequence — has no field. gate-chapter and gate-progression say gates exist but not what order the spaces come in, and mechanics is addressed to a different reader.
